name: 4D Tetrahedron Slicing (Geometry Shader)
definition: A method using the Geometry Shader to compute 4D tetrahedron cross-sections. It uses adjacency primitives to pass all four vertices to the shader simultaneously, avoiding data replication.
summary: This GPU method computes 3D cross-sections of 4D tetrahedra using adjacency primitives, avoiding data replication by replicating vertex data four times to drive parallel computation.
